rules: Reason IDs and labels are immutable within this proof-of-concept version.
Unknown IDs, aliases, free-text substitutes, and silent fallback codes are forbidden.
A reason never proves an intervention occurred unless the required intervention/evidence object exists.
The synthetic implementation must preserve exact business meaning while using only fictional inputs.

reasons.label: SOURCE_TAB_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
reasons.description: Monday/Wednesday/Friday tab was not explicitly confirmed. Do not import or read OA.

reasons.label: SOURCE_SCHEMA_UNRECOGNIZED
reasons.description: Versioned mapping cannot deterministically identify Order Number or Assigned Rep. Fail the current source-import attempt with zero portal reads. The parent run remains IN_PROGRESS; it terminalizes FAILED only if an authorized human explicitly accepts `FINALIZE_FAILED_SOURCE_IMPORT_NO_RETRY` under TR-004 branch A.

reasons.label: SOURCE_ROW_INVALID_ORDER_NUMBER
reasons.description: Reserved for a separately governed future schema that explicitly permits row-local invalidity; it is never emitted by `synthetic-doi-queue-v0.1`. In the locked schema, any populated-record A failure emits RC-002 + RC-090, fails run/import, creates no batch/work/case/evaluation, and performs zero OA reads.

reasons.label: SOURCE_ROW_UNRECOGNIZED_ASSIGNEE
reasons.description: Scalar assignee is blank/unrecognized under the exact normalizer. Do not guess; persist no row/order identity and do not read OA for it.

reasons.label: SOURCE_ROW_OUT_OF_SCOPE
reasons.description: Scalar assignee deterministically does not equal TARGET_REP. Count only; persist no row/order identity and do not read OA for it.

reasons.label: SOURCE_DUPLICATE_ROW_MERGED
reasons.description: Compatible TARGET_REP rows have the same exact Order Number. Merge to one staged order and preserve all TARGET_REP source refs.

reasons.label: SOURCE_ROW_CONFLICT
reasons.description: Unreachable under `synthetic-doi-queue-v0.1` because A/B contains no conflict-capable metadata and E:O is outside the row model; duplicate TARGET_REP rows always merge with RC-006. A future mapping must version and govern explicit row metadata before RC-007 can become reachable.

reasons.label: SOURCE_ASSIGNEE_CONFLICT
reasons.description: Same valid Order Number is assigned to TARGET_REP and a nonblank non-TARGET_REP scalar assignee in the coherent import. TR-103 appends one run-local rejected record, no staged order/work/case, and zero OA reads for that number.

reasons.label: SOURCE_CHANGED_DURING_IMPORT
reasons.description: Defensive version/readback evidence proves the selected synthetic source changed during import. Fail the current attempt; no executable batch/work proceeds from it. The parent run remains IN_PROGRESS; it terminalizes FAILED only through the explicit accepted no-retry command under TR-004 branch A.

reasons.label: SOURCE_ABSENT_RECHECK_REQUIRED
reasons.description: Previously active TARGET_REP case is absent from the new batch. Absence never closes; perform one read-only disappearance verification.

reasons.label: EXTRACTION_REQUIRED_IDENTITY_MISSING
reasons.description: Exact requested Order Number cannot be proved on the read surface. Create no snapshot/evaluation.

reasons.label: EXTRACTION_WHOLE_ORDER_UNPROVEN
reasons.description: Proof that every relevant line was captured is absent or inconsistent. Create no snapshot/evaluation.

reasons.label: EXTRACTION_REQUIRED_DATA_UNREADABLE
reasons.description: Required source data is missing/unreadable rather than successfully observed. It is not UNKNOWN; create no snapshot/evaluation.

reasons.label: EXTRACTION_FAILED
reasons.description: Umbrella failure code paired with at least one specific extraction reason. Set RECHECK_REQUIRED.

reasons.label: RECHECK_REQUIRED
reasons.description: A failed/incomplete extraction or unresolved verification requires a new explicit read-only recheck.

reasons.label: UNKNOWN_LINE_AVAILABILITY
reasons.description: Availability was successfully observed but cannot be safely normalized. Exclude the line from available-to-ship value and contain uncertainty.

reasons.label: UNKNOWN_LINE_DS_STATE
reasons.description: DS value was successfully observed but cannot be safely normalized. Do not infer DS/non-DS for that line.

reasons.label: LINE_CONTINUITY_UNVERIFIED
reasons.description: Cross-snapshot lineage is not deterministic. Row position is insufficient; block lineage-dependent conclusions.

reasons.label: FULL_DS
reasons.description: At least one relevant active merchandise line exists and every such line is explicitly DS. DOI state is DOI_EXCLUDED; no purge begins solely from this evaluation.

reasons.label: MIXED_DS
reasons.description: At least one active DS and one active non-DS line exist. Preserve non-DS analysis and emit DS_SEPARATION_REQUIRED.

reasons.label: SHIPPED
reasons.description: Complete OA snapshot verifies fully shipped. DOI_EXCLUDED; hard-close and schedule 90-day purge.

reasons.label: CANCELED
reasons.description: Complete OA snapshot verifies fully canceled. DOI_EXCLUDED; hard-close and schedule 90-day purge.

reasons.label: REP_TRANSFERRED
reasons.description: Complete OA snapshot verifies order assigned away from TARGET_REP. Reversible close and schedule purge.

reasons.label: DEDUPE_CONFIRMED
reasons.description: Read-only OA recheck verifies DEDUPE note. Reversible close and schedule purge.

reasons.label: HUMAN_OUT_OF_SCOPE_CLOSED
reasons.description: Authorized human explicitly closes as out of scope. Reversible close and schedule purge.

reasons.label: PAYMENT_ISSUE_OUT_OF_SCOPE
reasons.description: Payment is the sole non-progression reason. DOI_EXCLUDED; no purge begins solely from this evaluation.

reasons.label: PAYMENT_ISSUE_PRESENT_OUT_OF_SCOPE
reasons.description: Payment issue coexists with a product-side opportunity. Preserve the opportunity and surface payment before action.

reasons.label: ORDER_PROGRESS_REVIEW
reasons.description: Active unshipped order has all relevant active non-DS lines explicitly IN_STOCK/FULL. DOI_MANUAL_REVIEW without a release recommendation.

reasons.label: NO_ACTION_REQUIRED
reasons.description: Human review finds normal or out-of-scope progression with no current useful intervention. DOI_MONITOR.

reasons.label: DS_SEPARATION_REQUIRED
reasons.description: MIXED_DS is proved. Recommend human DS separation; never perform it.

reasons.label: FULFILLMENT_SPLIT_CANDIDATE
reasons.description: At least one active non-DS IN_STOCK/FULL line and one active non-DS DELAYED line. No minimum value/duration.

reasons.label: PARTIAL_QTY_INTERVENTION_REVIEW
reasons.description: Exact 0 < available quantity < active quantity. Calculate partial value when possible; never auto-recommend partial split.

reasons.label: EXACT_SKU_RECHECK
reasons.description: Same ordered ES has a plausible current availability/lead improvement. It is not an alternate; OA confirmation is required.

reasons.label: EXACT_MFG_ALTERNATE
reasons.description: Different ES, identical canonical MFG/OE, better current availability/lead, and valid relationship evidence. Customer approval required.

reasons.label: MFG_CROSS_REFERENCE
reasons.description: Different ES/MFG with explicit cross-reference evidence. Customer approval and any required compatibility review apply.

reasons.label: MFG_SUPERSESSION
reasons.description: Different ES/MFG with explicit supersession evidence. Preserve provenance; customer approval and any required compatibility review apply.

reasons.label: FUNCTIONAL_ALTERNATE
reasons.description: Different product may perform the function but is not exact/cross-reference/supersession. Fresh compatibility review and approval required.

reasons.label: NO_EXACT_MFG_ALTERNATE_FOUND
reasons.description: Completed research found no verified different-ES identical-MFG candidate. Does not prove no other alternate exists.

reasons.label: NO_VERIFIED_ALTERNATE_FOUND
reasons.description: Completed supported research found no verified safe alternate. Does not itself prove DEDUPE eligibility.

reasons.label: MANUAL_IDENTIFICATION_REQUIRED
reasons.description: Ordered product/application cannot be identified strongly enough. Human review required; DEDUPE blocked.

reasons.label: NO_VIABLE_ALTERNATE_HUMAN_CONFIRMED
reasons.description: Human completed review and explicitly confirmed no viable alternate. Does not itself close or write DEDUPE.

reasons.label: CUSTOMER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED
reasons.description: Every substitution requires customer approval before manual OA execution.

reasons.label: HUMAN_COMPATIBILITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED
reasons.description: Functional alternate, or non-deterministic cross-reference/supersession, requires human application/fitment review.

reasons.label: ALTERNATE_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED
reasons.description: A durable relationship exists but no new current-action observation exists. Research may surface; contact/substitution gate remains closed.

reasons.label: ALTERNATE_OBSERVATION_STALE
reasons.description: Observation remains stored or was found in history but is not from the current explicit action context. Never treat as current.

reasons.label: ALTERNATE_RELATIONSHIP_SUPERSEDED
reasons.description: Explicit source-grounded evidence identifies a successor relationship. ACTIVE → SUPERSEDED.

reasons.label: ALTERNATE_RELATIONSHIP_INVALIDATED
reasons.description: Explicit contradictory evidence invalidates the relationship. ACTIVE → INVALIDATED.

reasons.label: FUNCTIONAL_ALTERNATE_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED
reasons.description: Prior functional knowledge is reused for a new order/application. Re-review compatibility before action.

reasons.label: AK_HI_SHIPPING_REVIEW
reasons.description: Geography is Alaska/Hawaii class. Human review required before split; customer contact case-by-case.

reasons.label: INTERNATIONAL_ORDER_REVIEW
reasons.description: Geography is outside the 50-state operational class, including territories, APO/FPO, and Washington D.C. Human review required.

reasons.label: CUSTOMER_CONTACT_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SPLIT
reasons.description: International split handling requires customer contact before manual split.

reasons.label: HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED
reasons.description: Locked rule delegates commercial or non-routine choice to an authorized human; it is not proof of action.

reasons.label: WWC_ACTIVE_SELF
reasons.description: Latest qualifying WWC is by TARGET_REP. Ongoing work may continue; suppress new outreach only.

reasons.label: WWC_ACTIVE_OTHER_REP
reasons.description: Latest qualifying WWC is another rep and the next-business-date eligibility boundary has not arrived. Analysis continues; TARGET_REP contact/work and DEDUPE are blocked.

reasons.label: WWC_AUTHOR_UNCERTAIN
reasons.description: WWC author cannot be safely classified. Never guess; require coordination review.

reasons.label: TIMING_UNCERTAIN
reasons.description: WWC timestamp/calendar result cannot be safely established. Never assume protection expired.

reasons.label: HUMAN_COORDINATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED
reasons.description: WWC author/timing ambiguity needs human resolution. Preserve known opportunities.

reasons.label: DEDUPE_CANDIDATE
reasons.description: Complete one-pass analysis finds no unresolved/actionable DOI solution. Human decision required; system never writes OA note.

reasons.label: DEDUPE_BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE_ANALYSIS
reasons.description: Any opportunity, partial quantity, unknown-concealed opportunity, manual identification, active other-rep WWC, or incomplete research remains.

reasons.label: INTERVENTION_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
reasons.description: A change is detected but action identity/causation is not proved. Create no intervention or realized credit.

reasons.label: INTERVENTION_ACTION_SYSTEM_VERIFIED
reasons.description: Deterministic source evidence proves actual human action. Create/reuse intervention with SYSTEM_VERIFIED provenance.

reasons.label: INTERVENTION_ACTION_HUMAN_VERIFIED
reasons.description: Authorized human exactly attests actual completed action with structured evidence. Create/reuse intervention with HUMAN_VERIFIED provenance.

reasons.label: INTERVENTION_VALUE_UNVERIFIED
reasons.description: A verified credit-bearing split/substitution action has no exact accepted realized value, so value is UNVERIFIED and realized money is zero. It is mandatory even when an independent date/currency gate also fails, and forbidden for DS_SEPARATION/NOT_APPLICABLE.

reasons.label: INTERVENTION_VALUE_SYSTEM_VERIFIED
reasons.description: System-grounded evidence proves exact realized value. Use for current KPI.

reasons.label: INTERVENTION_VALUE_HUMAN_VERIFIED
reasons.description: Human provides exact known realized value. Count unless later authoritative system evidence conflicts.

reasons.label: INTERVENTION_VALUE_CONFLICT_SYSTEM_AUTHORITATIVE
reasons.description: While the detailed case remains retained, later system value conflicts with human value. Preserve both; system value controls current KPI.

reasons.label: HUMAN_VALUE_NOT_EXACT
reasons.description: Human-provided amount is estimated, rounded, ranged, or otherwise not exact. Reject verification; KPI remains zero.

reasons.label: INTERVENTION_PARTIALLY_REVERSED
reasons.description: Verified reversal is greater than zero and less than original realized value.

reasons.label: INTERVENTION_REVERSED
reasons.description: Verified reversal equals original realized value; net is zero.

reasons.label: RESULTING_ORDER_AUTO_LINKED
reasons.description: Deterministic allowed evidence proves child order relationship.

reasons.label: RESULTING_ORDER_HUMAN_CONFIRMED
reasons.description: Authorized human verifies child relationship with structured evidence.

reasons.label: RESULTING_ORDER_LINK_REVIEW
reasons.description: A candidate search is ambiguous, or an existing exact link has unresolved mapping conflict. Keep search and exact-link streams distinct; human/exact resolution is required and disputed split credit is unverified.

reasons.label: RESULTING_ORDER_NOT_FOUND
reasons.description: A complete search finds no exact resulting order. Append only search-state NOT_FOUND; do not create an exact link, child identity, mapping, or realized split credit.

reasons.label: SPLIT_CREDIT_REP_UNVERIFIED
reasons.description: Resulting order-level TARGET_REP rep is missing/different/ambiguous. Realized split credit is zero until resolved.

reasons.label: SWAP_CREDIT_REP_UNVERIFIED
reasons.description: Replacement line-level TARGET_REP rep is missing/different/ambiguous. Order-level rep cannot substitute; realized swap credit is zero.

reasons.label: CREDIT_DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED
reasons.description: Same verified action-evidence fingerprint or credit unit was encountered again. Reuse original intervention; add no credit.

reasons.label: REVERSAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
reasons.description: Potential removal/cancellation of credited merchandise is detected but exact reversal is not proved. Preserve prior verified totals pending verification.

reasons.label: CASE_REOPENED
reasons.description: Before purge, explicit recheck provides source-grounded eligibility after reversible closure. Reuse the retained case and cancel purge.

reasons.label: PURGE_SCHEDULED
reasons.description: Verified terminal transition schedules detailed-data purge at exact `calendar90(terminal_closed_at)`; persist UTC plus retention-policy/timezone-database versions.

reasons.label: PURGE_CANCELED_ON_REOPEN
reasons.description: A reversible closure reopens before purge only after `CaseReopenPayloadV2` and `PURGE_CANCELED` each carry the complete explicit `PriorClosureRetentionBindingV1` copied byte-for-byte from the locked pre-event closure/retention projection. The canceled deadline must equal that binding's `prior_purge_eligible_at`; then clear the deadline on the same retained case.

reasons.label: STATE_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED
reasons.description: Requested/derived transition is unlisted or violates its guard. Attention examples include wrong/inactive cause key, wrong SET reference, incomplete resolver group, illegal reason/null partition, or conflicting CLEAR identity. Reject and preserve last valid projection.

reasons.label: OA_WRITE_PROHIBITED
reasons.description: Requested capability or operation could mutate OA. It must not exist or execute.

reasons.label: UNSAFE_ACTION_REJECTED
reasons.description: A DOI request attempts an OA mutation, generic click/request, background poll, or unallowlisted side-effectful read path. Reject with no OA request.

reasons.label: RULE_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.owner: DOIEvaluation and DOIRun pre-extraction systemic rules gate
reasons.description: The exact requested current or historical rules binding cannot be loaded. At the evaluation gate, create no evaluation under a substitute version and follow the governed evaluation-level route. At the run pre-extraction gate, when a valid run already exists and the exact rules binding becomes unavailable before extraction reservation, TR-004 branch B terminalizes the run FAILED with exact {RC-084}, appends no evaluation, performs zero portal reads, and records zero order dispositions.

reasons.label: VALUE_CALCULATION_UNAVAILABLE
reasons.description: Required exact quantity/value/classification inputs are unavailable. Return UNAVAILABLE, never an inferred or silently zero value.

reasons.label: CASE_IDENTITY_NOT_RETAINED
reasons.description: A requested case-linked correction, reversal, or reconciliation targets no retained case/intervention identity, including after purge. Reject without reconstruction, tombstone/hash lookup, aggregate change, or a persistent order-specific rejection record.

reasons.label: POTENTIAL_OVERLAP_UNRESOLVED
reasons.description: Potential opportunities address overlapping/mutually exclusive merchandise scopes and no explicit scenario selection exists. Keep opportunity values separate and overall potential UNAVAILABLE.

reasons.label: AGGREGATE_KPI_FINALIZED
reasons.description: At purge, atomically transfer the case's then-current exact contribution into non-identifying finalized aggregate history before deleting its entire per-order graph. Retain no per-case delta or linkage.

reasons.label: SOURCE_UNREADABLE_OR_INACCESSIBLE
reasons.description: The confirmed synthetic source or a required read cannot be accessed. The current attempt fails with no batch/work/case and zero portal reads. The parent run remains IN_PROGRESS; it terminalizes FAILED only through the explicit accepted no-retry command under TR-004 branch A.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: SOURCE_IMPORT_ATTEMPT_FAILED
reasons.description: Umbrella required on each failed import with at least one exact specific source reason; never replaces the specific code.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: SOURCE_BATCH_IDENTITY_INTEGRITY_CONFLICT
reasons.description: The same digest maps to different canonical identity material or an incompatible payload. Fail the current attempt before any portal read; do not overwrite, reuse, or create a conflicting batch. The parent run remains IN_PROGRESS; it terminalizes FAILED only through the explicit accepted no-retry command under TR-004 branch A.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: SOURCE_REJECTED_IDENTITY_RETENTION_SCHEDULED
reasons.description: Run terminalized; schedule exact no-case identity deletion at `calendar90(run.completed_at)` without extension by batch reuse.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: SOURCE_REJECTED_IDENTITY_PURGED
reasons.description: At eligibility the exact rejected identity and joinable detail are deleted atomically. RC-093 exists only inside the deleting transaction and no rejection reason, dimension, event, receipt, hash, record/order/source reference, or separate rejection aggregate survives commit.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: CURRENCY_CODE_INVALID
reasons.description: A supplied code/scale/representation/registry binding is invalid. Create no Money/row/bucket; infer no USD/FX. A merely absent pre-value currency is not RC-094.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: MIXED_CURRENCY_AGGREGATION_PROHIBITED
reasons.description: A scalar would combine currencies. Return segmented results and no combined value or FX inference.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: RETENTION_CLOCK_CALCULATION_FAILED
reasons.description: Policy/timezone binding or DST resolution cannot produce exact UTC. Schedule no approximate/earlier purge.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: OPPORTUNITY_SCOPE_UNPROVEN
reasons.description: Required immutable line identity/quantity/continuity is unproved. Create no candidate opportunity or potential/credit.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: SCENARIO_OPTION_SELECTION_CONFLICT
reasons.description: Multiple options selected for one overlap key or option is outside the group/evaluation. Reject selection; emit no group/combined total.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: KPI_ACTION_DATE_UNVERIFIED
reasons.description: Credit-bearing verified action lacks exact business occurrence instant/local attribution date. Evidence/review/ingestion/record time cannot substitute; retain operational evidence but create no contribution/date bucket.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: KPI_BUCKET_IDENTITY_CONFLICT
reasons.description: Derived daily date/bounds/currency/class conflicts with stored identity. Roll back; do not move or duplicate money.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: KPI_FINALIZATION_CONFLICT
reasons.description: Ledger/bucket projection fails pre-finalization reconciliation. Roll back both KPI transfer and case deletion.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: EVIDENCE_NATURAL_KEY_CONFLICT
reasons.description: Same ACTION/original-value/reversal logical key has a different material effect without legal correction. Preserve last valid projection; apply no disputed effect. Exact parent/type/child mapping conflict is excluded and uses RC-104 + RC-072.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: EVIDENCE_FINGERPRINT_INTEGRITY_FAILURE
reasons.description: One SHA-256 value maps to different canonical bytes for a key/evidence/mapping payload. Roll back the affected transaction. At a registered pre-OA source/integrity gate this may terminalize the run FAILED with RC-090; after any OA work began it is an order exception and a coherent run terminalizes COMPLETED_WITH_EXCEPTIONS, never FAILED solely for this post-OA collision.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: RESULTING_ORDER_LINK_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT
reasons.description: Same parent/type/child natural link has contradictory moved-line/quantity mapping. Set review/ambiguous; add RC-072; disputed split credit zero.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: EVALUATION_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE
reasons.description: Required snapshot/rules/calendar/relationship-revision/observation/human-fact binding absent, wrong-scope, or unresolved. Append no evaluation.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: EVALUATION_PROVENANCE_HASH_MISMATCH
reasons.description: Bound version/ID resolves but canonical digest differs. Append no evaluation; never substitute another version.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: ALTERNATE_RELATIONSHIP_CREATED
reasons.description: Valid product-only evidence creates one stable relationship and immutable revision 1.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: ALTERNATE_RELATIONSHIP_REVISION_APPENDED
reasons.description: Accepted explicit product-only change appends exactly revision n+1; prior revisions unchanged.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: ALTERNATE_RELATIONSHIP_REVISION_CONFLICT
reasons.description: With an otherwise valid current envelope, semantic content is illegal: identity-field mutation inside a revision, event-type/state mismatch, unsupported product content, or terminal relationship reactivation. Reject append and retain projection. Sequence, revision-number, predecessor, full-event-hash, stream-ID, and event-identity conflicts use RC-111 exclusively.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: ACTION_CONTEXT_BINDING_INVALID
reasons.description: Context absent/closed/wrong case-evaluation-opportunity-kind, or fact is not explicitly linked. It cannot satisfy readiness.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: EVENT_STREAM_SEQUENCE_CONFLICT
reasons.description: Proposed append has stale sequence/predecessor/digest or reuses event identity with different canonical bytes. Reject; retain projection; RC-103 also applies to a detected digest collision.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: HUMAN_FACT_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE
reasons.description: Actor/scope/fingerprint/provenance is incomplete, or a DEDUPE review/verification binding, fact-to-state-event mapping, current-decision guard, or legal correction predecessor is missing/conflicting. Reject fact/atomic DEDUPE bundle; do not evaluate from it.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: LIFECYCLE_EVENT_SCHEMA_INVALID
reasons.description: Unknown lifecycle kind/version/payload type; missing/extra field; wrong required/null/absent partition; illegal enum/alias/domain; actor/provenance or typed-event binding mismatch; incorrect natural-key, payload, projection, or full-event hash. For reopen/purge cancellation this includes an omitted, hash-only, inferred, or non-byte-equal `PriorClosureRetentionBindingV1`, any mismatched binding member, and any canceled deadline different from the locked prior deadline. Block and reject before append; preserve the prior closure, deadline, and projection. Stream predecessor/revision faults remain RC-111; proven digest collisions remain RC-103; unlisted state edges remain RC-081.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: SOURCE_IMPORT_ATTEMPT_PURGED
reasons.description: At TR-114 eligibility, emit/assert RC-114 only inside the deletion transaction, then atomically delete one terminal source-import-attempt graph, its attempt-owned run/source links, attempt-owned batch/reference edges, indexes/caches/logs/temp artifacts, and the transient purge event/reason itself. Delete the run identity graph only when its own deadline is due and the closed last-reference predicate is true. Only `DOISourceImportAggregateV2` month, outcome class, and count may survive; it retains no reason code, tombstone, hash, or reversible lookup.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: UNKNOWN_LINE_ETA_STATE
reasons.description: The ETA field was successfully observed, but its raw value could not be safely normalized into the closed ETA tagged-value model. Preserve the line's other independently known source facts and block only conclusions whose complete basis depends on ETA. Do not infer a date, lead time, terminal state, availability state, or DS state, and never reuse a stale ETA. A narrowly bounded, field-allowlisted, non-sensitive raw ETA hint may be retained only under the existing UNKNOWN/raw-hint privacy contract. Missing, unreadable, inaccessible, or unobserved required ETA data is extraction failure. RC-115 does not substitute for RC-016, RC-017, or RC-085 and authorizes no OA action or write.
reasons.source_section: 12. Carried-forward source, retention, currency, KPI, provenance, and history additions

reasons.label: UNKNOWN_ORDER_STATE
reasons.description: The exact field DOIOrderSnapshot.order_state was successfully observed but cannot be normalized. Preserve independent facts and block only ORDER_STATE_ONLY. Missing or unreadable input remains extraction failure.

reasons.label: UNKNOWN_CURRENT_REP_VALUE
reasons.description: The exact field DOIOrderSnapshot.current_rep_value was successfully observed but cannot be normalized. Preserve independent facts and block only REP_VALUE_ONLY. Missing or unreadable input remains extraction failure.

reasons.label: UNKNOWN_CURRENT_REP_RELATION
reasons.description: The exact field DOIOrderSnapshot.current_rep_relation was successfully observed but cannot be normalized. Preserve independent facts and block only REP_RELATION_ONLY. Missing or unreadable input remains extraction failure.

reasons.label: UNKNOWN_GEOGRAPHY_CLASS
reasons.description: The exact field DOIOrderSnapshot.geography_class was successfully observed but cannot be normalized. Preserve independent facts and block only GEOGRAPHY_ONLY. Missing or unreadable input remains extraction failure.

reasons.label: UNKNOWN_PAYMENT_CONDITION
reasons.description: The exact field DOIOrderSnapshot.payment_condition was successfully observed but cannot be normalized. Preserve independent facts and block only PAYMENT_ONLY. Missing or unreadable input remains extraction failure.

reasons.label: UNKNOWN_ORDER_TOTAL
